$schema_note: Matches the GitHub Copilot hooks reference (https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference) as of 2026-07: top-level 'version', hook entries use 'bash' (not 'command'), paths are relative to the repo root (no ${workspaceFolder} templating — that's a VS Code task/launch variable, not a hooks.json field), and matcher values are the real tool names (bash/edit/create, plus Claude Code's PascalCase equivalents Bash/Edit/Write since this same file is read by both). All three scripts unconditionally exit 0 — preToolUse hooks fail-closed (deny) on any other non-zero exit, so exit-0 is what makes these actually warn-only rather than merely intended to be.
